instruction: Open /home/user/Desktop/freecad_task-18_input.step. Keep the base fixed at X=0..100, Y=0..70, Z=0..10. Rotate the loose vertical plate 90 degrees about Z and move it onto the base top face so it spans X=20..80, Y=31..39, Z=10..54. Move the two locator blocks onto the base without fusing: the 12 x 12 x 12 block must span X=16..28, Y=12..24, Z=10..22, and the 12 x 12 x 14 block must span X=72..84, Y=46..58, Z=10..24. Keep the base, plate, and two locator blocks as four separate solids. Export /home/user/Desktop/freecad_task-18_output.step. [Software] To use FreeCAD, run `freecad` from a terminal (use the full executable path if it is not on PATH). For this task, use `/usr/lib/freecad/bin/freecadcmd-python3` for the FreeCAD command-line work in this task when working on `freecad_task-18_input.step`.
